title: Quantum Computing and Error Mitigation with Deep Learning for Frenkel Excitons
summary: Quantum computers, currently in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, have started to provide scientists with a novel tool to explore quantum physics and chemistry. While several electronic systems have been extensively studied, Frenkel excitons, as prototypical optical excitations, remain among the less-explored applications. Here, we first use variational quantum deflation to calculate the eigenstates of the Frenkel Hamiltonian and evaluate the observables based on the oscillator strength for each eigenstate.
